key_idea: With length at most 100, try every substring as the macro and count non-overlapping occurrences greedily from the left.
sketch: For each substring m of length L >= 2, scan left to right taking a match whenever one starts at the current position (leftmost greedy maximises the count of non-overlapping occurrences of a fixed pattern); cost is n - cnt*(L-1) + L. Take the minimum with n (no macro). O(n^4) worst case about 10^8 trivial char ops at n=100, in practice far less; fine.
